# Speechling

> > Speechling is a language learning platform offering pronunciation guides, audio dictionaries, and grammar lessons for French, Spanish, Chinese (Mandarin), Japanese, Italian, German, Russian, and English with multilingual interface support.

Speechling provides comprehensive language learning resources including Pinyin-based Chinese pronunciation guides, phrase translations, and vocabulary lessons. The platform features an official blog with language learning tips and extensive how-to guides available in multiple interface languages including Russian.

## Key Topics

- Speechling platform
- Pronunciation guides
- Audio dictionaries
- Mandarin Chinese with Pinyin
- French learning
- Spanish learning
- German learning
- Japanese learning
- Russian interface
- Grammar lessons
- Vocabulary building
- Travel phrases
- Language translation
- Native speaker audio

## Blog & Learning Resources

- [Speechling Official Blog](https://blog.speechling.com/): Official blog with language learning tips for French, Spanish, Chinese, etc.

## Chinese (Mandarin) Pronunciation Guides

- [Как сказать "Говорить" на китайском (说话)](https://speechling.com/how-to/kak-skazat-govoryt-na-kytaiskom-2391): Russian guide: how to say 'to speak' in Chinese with Pinyin & audio
- [Как сказать "Девять" на китайском (九)](https://speechling.com/how-to/kak-skazat-deviat-na-kytaiskom-3305): Russian guide: Chinese number 9 with Pinyin pronunciation
- [Как сказать "Пять" на китайском (五)](https://speechling.com/how-to/kak-skazat-piat-na-kytaiskom-3301): Russian guide: Chinese number 5 with Pinyin pronunciation

## German Pronunciation Guides

- [Как сказать "Хорошо" на немецком (Das ist gut)](https://speechling.com/how-to/kak-skazat-khorosho-na-nemetskom-1099): Russian guide: how to say 'good' in German with pronunciation
